section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Functionality Appreciation Scale (FAS), a 7-item instrument used to assess how much individuals appreciate and respect their body for its functions. The FAS uses a 5-point Likert scale and has demonstrated good psychometric properties including one-dimensional structure, invariance across sex, adequate internal consistency and test-retest reliability, and good validity. In the present study, the ordinal coefficient for the FAS was .92.
